limitations: Original run remains FAIL. Guest exit0 means collection/poweroff completed, not product recovery.
The initial SIGKILL epoch has no stopped/backend-terminal snapshot. Its last pending/queued/inflight/budget/reap totals cannot be replaced with zeros from the new process.
Restart clean/available/current=original=None describes a new no-IMPORT baseline, and does not certify the old usbhid/ftdi_sio baseline restored.
20.06s is the completed observation window with final same-generation unbound drivers, not a permanent-state or performance claim.
PID/fd disappearance is not proof of all OFD references terminated or revocable-capability ownership; no general supervisor recovery is established.

No raw wire frame capture was retained; actual IMPORT/transfer facts are supported by kernel client receipts/events, real I/O bytes, worker counters, process/FD/sysfs observations and frozen guest exact assertions.
Only disposable QEMU HID/FTDI with private socketpair was exercised; this is not hardwareG1/G2, arbitrary composite/alternate, or helper/supervisor crash acceptance.
Run clean provenance is retained separately from later archive-time documentation/untracked evidence changes.
